known.via: English Wikipedia "Slovenska Istra" (redirects to "Slovene Istria") (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: Slovene Istria, the northern part of the Istrian peninsula, in southwest Slovenia, with towns such as Koper, Izola and Piran. Refosco makes up 41 percent of plantings and Malvazija Istarska 34 percent. It allows wine and sparkling wine.
